name: TotA Meter
description: DPS meter and Build Tester for you and your pet: DPS and peak, damage per skill, max hit, uses per minute, crits, estimated focus per cast, combos, damage by type and Combat/Alt deck split, and a 5-minute Build Tester on the Training Dummy with 29 performance KPIs (burst, hit quality, rhythm, stability, focus) for 0-1, 1-3 and 3-5 minutes. Tracks artifacts, Crowns of the Obsidians and blueprints you loot. Makes three codes to paste in Import on Tools of the Avatar: your Combat and Alt decks with their exact slots, your adventurer skills and XP, your producer skills and XP.
author: Tools of the Avatar
